fullDescription: Deliver Jutsu Audio in usable vertical slices. Each phase must preserve one shared project/audio core for GUI and CLI, deterministic serialized state, real-time-safe playback, structured machine interfaces, and extension points for synths, effects, and generators. Complete child phases in order through explicit dependencies; no implementation is part of this planning task.
shortDescription: Incremental Rust desktop audio editor roadmap with shared GUI/CLI core, live synchronization, deterministic generation, and extensible audio systems.
title: Build Jutsu Audio from minimal editor to extensible production tool
